line: Heartwood is an invented 2016 small-group DVD course (Leader's Edition); what it teaches is quoted from real booklets sold to women, 1987–2016, numbered in the bar [1]–[4], and the 1993 Exodus floppy-disc analogy is read word for word.
made: Script, design, animation and sound: Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5), UiB job 28 (S395), from v5 (job 27, S393) and the look test he approved on 16 Nov 2026.
music: Music: made in code for these tapes by Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5), the v4 Heartwood music (2016-V4), his pick by ear.
voices: Build-time Supertonic 3 (OpenRAIL-M) through tools/tts/render.py, register apparatus: presenter F5 at 0.95 (16 steps), trailer announcer F2 at 1.04 (14 steps). No real person is voiced, shown or named.
